title: Room list: rooms the user follows, the open room, unread badges
spec: Implement RoomList in crates/ui-model/src/room_list.rs as its doc comments say: add refuses blank and exactly-duplicate names; rows are sorted by name ignoring ASCII case, exact name breaking ties; select returns Command::Sync only for a listed room that is not already selected, and clears its unread; the selected room's unread stays 0; total_unread saturates. Replace the `_todo` field and remove the clippy::todo allow. No new dependencies.
